title: Cannon Beach History Center And Museum

services.name: Current Exhibits
services.desc: Our exhibits are designed to entertain the history buff, natural scientist, artist, and lover of all things Cannon Beach. We have two rotating exhibits (one art/history and one local history), and several permanent features of the museum. The Cannon Beach History Center and Museum presents Sue Gordon: A Trailblazer for Women, Education, and the Arts, an exhibition honoring the life and enduring impact of Sue Gordon, founder of the Cannon Beach Haystack ’69 program and a pioneering advocate for women, education, and the arts.
